rules.author: Avneet Singh @v3t0_, oscd.community

rules.title: Use of TTDInject.exe
rules.description: Detects the executiob of TTDInject.exe, which is used by Windows 10 v1809 and newer to debug time travel (underlying call of tttracer.exe)
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Time Travel Debugging Utility Usage
rules.description: Detects usage of Time Travel Debugging Utility. Adversaries can execute malicious processes and dump processes, such as lsass.exe, via tttracer.exe.
rules.author: Ensar Şamil, @sblmsrsn, @oscd_initiative

rules.title: Lolbin Unregmp2.exe Use As Proxy
rules.description: Detect usage of the "unregmp2.exe" binary as a proxy to launch a custom version of "wmpnscfg.exe"
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: UtilityFunctions.ps1 Proxy Dll
rules.description: Detects the use of a Microsoft signed script executing a managed DLL with PowerShell.
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Visual Basic Command Line Compiler Usage
rules.description: Detects successful code compilation via Visual Basic Command Line Compiler that utilizes Windows Resource to Object Converter.
rules.author: Ensar Şamil, @sblmsrsn, @oscd_initiative

rules.title: Use of VisualUiaVerifyNative.exe
rules.description: VisualUiaVerifyNative.exe is a Windows SDK that can be used for AWL bypass and is listed in Microsoft's recommended block rules.
rules.author: Christopher Peacock @SecurePeacock, SCYTHE @scythe_io

rules.title: Use of VSIISExeLauncher.exe
rules.description: The "VSIISExeLauncher.exe" binary part of the Visual Studio/VS Code can be used to execute arbitrary binaries
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Use of Wfc.exe
rules.description: The Workflow Command-line Compiler can be used for AWL bypass and is listed in Microsoft's recommended block rules.
rules.author: Christopher Peacock @SecurePeacock, SCYTHE @scythe_io

rules.title: Potential Register_App.Vbs LOLScript Abuse
rules.description: Detects potential abuse of the "register_app.vbs" script that is part of the Windows SDK. The script offers the capability to register new VSS/VDS Provider as a COM+ application. Attackers can use this to install malicious DLLs for persistence and execution.
rules.author: Austin Songer @austinsonger

rules.title: Potential Credential Dumping Via LSASS Process Clone
rules.description: Detects a suspicious LSASS process process clone that could be a sign of credential dumping activity
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Samir Bousseaden

rules.title: Potential Mftrace.EXE Abuse
rules.description: Detects child processes of the "Trace log generation tool for Media Foundation Tools" (Mftrace.exe) which can abused to execute arbitrary binaries.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Windows Default Domain GPO Modification via GPME
rules.description:
Detects the use of the Group Policy Management Editor (GPME) to modify Default Domain or Default Domain Controllers Group Policy Objects (GPOs).
Adversaries may leverage GPME to make stealthy changes in these default GPOs to deploy malicious GPOs configurations across the domain without raising suspicion.
rules.author: TropChaud

rules.title: MMC20 Lateral Movement
rules.description: Detects MMC20.Application Lateral Movement; specifically looks for the spawning of the parent MMC.exe with a command line of "-Embedding" as a child of svchost.exe
rules.author: @2xxeformyshirt (Security Risk Advisors) - rule; Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea)

rules.title: MMC Executing Files with Reversed Extensions Using RTLO Abuse
rules.description: Detects malicious behavior where the MMC utility (`mmc.exe`) executes files with reversed extensions caused by Right-to-Left Override (RLO) abuse, disguising them as document formats.
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: MMC Spawning Windows Shell
rules.description: Detects a Windows command line executable started from MMC
rules.author: Karneades, Swisscom CSIRT

rules.title: CodePage Modification Via MODE.COM To Russian Language
rules.description:
Detects a CodePage modification using the "mode.com" utility to Russian language.
This behavior has been used by threat actors behind Dharma ransomware.
rules.author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk

rules.title: Potential Suspicious Mofcomp Execution
rules.description:
Detects execution of the "mofcomp" utility as a child of a suspicious shell or script running utility or by having a suspicious path in the commandline.
The "mofcomp" utility parses a file containing MOF statements and adds the classes and class instances defined in the file to the WMI repository.
Attackers abuse this utility to install malicious MOF scripts
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Potential Mpclient.DLL Sideloading Via Defender Binaries
rules.description: Detects potential sideloading of "mpclient.dll" by Windows Defender processes ("MpCmdRun" and "NisSrv") from their non-default directory.
rules.detection_summary: {'selection': {'Image|endswith': ['\\MpCmdRun.exe', '\\NisSrv.exe']}, 'filter_main_known_locations': {'Image|startswith': ['C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Windows Defender\\', 'C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Security Client\\', 'C:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\', 'C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\', 'C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\']}, 'condition': 'selection and not 1 of filter_main_*'}
rules.author: Bhabesh Raj

rules.title: File Download Via Windows Defender MpCmpRun.EXE
rules.description: Detects the use of Windows Defender MpCmdRun.EXE to download files
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': [{'OriginalFileName': 'MpCmdRun.exe'}, {'Image|endswith': '\\MpCmdRun.exe'}, {'CommandLine|contains': 'MpCmdRun.exe'}, {'Description': 'Microsoft Malware Protection Command Line Utility'}], 'selection_cli': {'CommandLine|contains|all': ['DownloadFile', 'url']}, 'condition': 'all of selection_*'}
rules.author: Matthew Matchen

rules.title: Windows Defender Definition Files Removed
rules.description: Adversaries may disable security tools to avoid possible detection of their tools and activities by removing Windows Defender Definition Files
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Suspicious Msbuild Execution By Uncommon Parent Process
rules.description: Detects suspicious execution of 'Msbuild.exe' by a uncommon parent process
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: MSDT Execution Via Answer File
rules.description: Detects execution of "msdt.exe" using an answer file which is simulating the legitimate way of calling msdt via "pcwrun.exe" (For example from the compatibility tab).
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Potential Arbitrary Command Execution Using Msdt.EXE
rules.description: Detects processes leveraging the "ms-msdt" handler or the "msdt.exe" binary to execute arbitrary commands as seen in the follina (CVE-2022-30190) vulnerability
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': [{'Image|endswith': '\\msdt.exe'}, {'OriginalFileName': 'msdt.exe'}], 'selection_cmd_inline': {'CommandLine|contains': 'IT_BrowseForFile='}, 'selection_cmd_answerfile_flag': {'CommandLine|contains': ' PCWDiagnostic'}, 'selection_cmd_answerfile_param': {'CommandLine|contains|windash': ' -af '}, 'condition': 'selection_img and (selection_cmd_inline or all of selection_cmd_answerfil
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Cabinet File Execution Via Msdt.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of msdt.exe using the "cab" flag which could indicates suspicious diagcab files with embedded answer files leveraging CVE-2022-30190
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), GossiTheDog, frack113

rules.title: Suspicious MSDT Parent Process
rules.description: Detects msdt.exe executed by a suspicious parent as seen in CVE-2022-30190 / Follina exploitation
rules.author: Nextron Systems

rules.title: Arbitrary File Download Via MSEDGE_PROXY.EXE
rules.description: Detects usage of "msedge_proxy.exe" to download arbitrary files
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel

rules.title: Remotely Hosted HTA File Executed Via Mshta.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of the "mshta" utility with an argument containing the "http" keyword, which could indicate that an attacker is executing a remotely hosted malicious hta file
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Wscript Shell Run In CommandLine
rules.description: Detects the presence of the keywords "Wscript", "Shell" and "Run" in the command, which could indicate a suspicious activity
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious JavaScript Execution Via Mshta.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of javascript code using "mshta.exe".
rules.author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Endgame), oscd.community

rules.title: Potential LethalHTA Technique Execution
rules.description: Detects potential LethalHTA technique where the "mshta.exe" is spawned by an "svchost.exe" process
rules.author: Markus Neis

rules.title: Suspicious MSHTA Child Process
rules.description: Detects a suspicious process spawning from an "mshta.exe" process, which could be indicative of a malicious HTA script execution
rules.author: Michael Haag

rules.title: MSHTA Execution with Suspicious File Extensions
rules.description:
Detects execution of mshta.exe with file types that looks like they do not typically represent HTA (HTML Application) content,
such as .png, .jpg, .zip, .pdf, and others, which are often polyglots. MSHTA is a legitimate Windows utility for executing HTML Applications
containing VBScript or JScript. Threat actors often abuse this lolbin utility to download and
execute malicious scripts disguised as benign files or hosted under misleading extensions to evade detection.
rules.author: Diego Perez (@darkquassar), Markus Neis, Swisscom (Improve Rule), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Mshta.EXE Execution Patterns
rules.description: Detects suspicious mshta process execution patterns
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: DllUnregisterServer Function Call Via Msiexec.EXE
rules.description: Detects MsiExec loading a DLL and calling its DllUnregisterServer function
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Suspicious MsiExec Embedding Parent
rules.description: Adversaries may abuse msiexec.exe to proxy the execution of malicious payloads
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Suspicious Msiexec Execute Arbitrary DLL
rules.description:
Adversaries may abuse msiexec.exe to proxy execution of malicious payloads.
Msiexec.exe is the command-line utility for the Windows Installer and is thus commonly associated with executing installation packages (.msi)
rules.detection_summary: {'selection': {'Image|endswith': '\\msiexec.exe', 'CommandLine|contains|windash': ' -y'}, 'filter_apple': {'CommandLine|contains': ['\\MsiExec.exe" /Y "C:\\Program Files\\Bonjour\\mdnsNSP.dll', '\\MsiExec.exe" /Y "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Bonjour\\mdnsNSP.dll', '\\MsiExec.exe" /Y "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Apple Software Update\\ScriptingObjectModel.dll', '\\MsiExec.exe" /Y "C:\\Program Files (x86)
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Msiexec Quiet Installation
rules.description:
Adversaries may abuse msiexec.exe to proxy execution of malicious payloads.
Msiexec.exe is the command-line utility for the Windows Installer and is thus commonly associated with executing installation packages (.msi)
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Suspicious Msiexec Quiet Install From Remote Location
rules.description: Detects usage of Msiexec.exe to install packages hosted remotely quietly
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Potential MsiExec Masquerading
rules.description: Detects the execution of msiexec.exe from an uncommon directory
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: MsiExec Web Install
rules.description: Detects suspicious msiexec process starts with web addresses as parameter
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Windows MSIX Package Support Framework AI_STUBS Execution
rules.description:
Detects execution of Advanced Installer MSIX Package Support Framework (PSF) components, specifically AI_STUBS executables with original filename 'popupwrapper.exe'.
This activity may indicate malicious MSIX packages build with Advanced Installer leveraging the Package Support Framework to bypass application control restrictions.
rules.author: Michael Haag, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Arbitrary File Download Via MSOHTMED.EXE
rules.description: Detects usage of "MSOHTMED" to download arbitrary files
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Arbitrary File Download Via MSPUB.EXE
rules.description: Detects usage of "MSPUB" (Microsoft Publisher) to download arbitrary files
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Potential Process Injection Via Msra.EXE
rules.description: Detects potential process injection via Microsoft Remote Asssistance (Msra.exe) by looking at suspicious child processes spawned from the aforementioned process. It has been a target used by many threat actors and used for discovery and persistence tactics
rules.author: Alexander McDonald

rules.title: Detection of PowerShell Execution via Sqlps.exe
rules.description:
This rule detects execution of a PowerShell code through the sqlps.exe utility, which is included in the standard set of utilities supplied with the MSSQL Server.
Script blocks are not logged in this case, so this utility helps to bypass protection mechanisms based on the analysis of these logs.
rules.author: Agro (@agro_sev) oscd.community

rules.title: SQL Client Tools PowerShell Session Detection
rules.description:
This rule detects execution of a PowerShell code through the sqltoolsps.exe utility, which is included in the standard set of utilities supplied with the Microsoft SQL Server Management studio.
Script blocks are not logged in this case, so this utility helps to bypass protection mechanisms based on the analysis of these logs.
rules.author: Agro (@agro_sev) oscd.communitly

rules.title: Suspicious Child Process Of SQL Server
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes of the SQLServer process. This could indicate potential RCE or SQL Injection.
rules.author: FPT.EagleEye Team, wagga

rules.title: Suspicious Child Process Of Veeam Dabatase
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes of the Veeam service process. This could indicate potential RCE or SQL Injection.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Potential MSTSC Shadowing Activity
rules.description: Detects RDP session hijacking by using MSTSC shadowing
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: New Remote Desktop Connection Initiated Via Mstsc.EXE
rules.description:
Detects the usage of "mstsc.exe" with the "/v" flag to initiate a connection to a remote server.
Adversaries may use valid accounts to log into a computer using the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user.
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': [{'Image|endswith': '\\mstsc.exe'}, {'OriginalFileName': 'mstsc.exe'}], 'selection_cli': {'CommandLine|contains|windash': ' /v:'}, 'filter_optional_wsl': {'ParentImage': 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\lxss\\wslhost.exe', 'CommandLine|contains': 'C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\WSL\\wslg.rdp'}, 'condition': 'all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*'}
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Mstsc.EXE Execution With Local RDP File
rules.description: Detects potential RDP connection via Mstsc using a local ".rdp" file
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': [{'Image|endswith': '\\mstsc.exe'}, {'OriginalFileName': 'mstsc.exe'}], 'selection_cli': {'CommandLine|endswith': ['.rdp', '.rdp"']}, 'filter_optional_wsl': {'ParentImage': 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\lxss\\wslhost.exe', 'CommandLine|contains': 'C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\WSL\\wslg.rdp'}, 'condition': 'all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*'}
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Christopher Peacock @securepeacock

rules.title: Suspicious Mstsc.EXE Execution With Local RDP File
rules.description: Detects potential RDP connection via Mstsc using a local ".rdp" file located in suspicious locations.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Mstsc.EXE Execution From Uncommon Parent
rules.description: Detects potential RDP connection via Mstsc using a local ".rdp" file located in suspicious locations.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Msxsl.EXE Execution
rules.description:
Detects the execution of the MSXSL utility. This can be used to execute Extensible Stylesheet Language (XSL) files. These files are commonly used to describe the processing and rendering of data within XML files.
Adversaries can abuse this functionality to execute arbitrary files while potentially bypassing application whitelisting defenses.
rules.author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community

rules.title: Remote XSL Execution Via Msxsl.EXE
rules.description: Detects the execution of the "msxsl" binary with an "http" keyword in the command line. This might indicate a potential remote execution of XSL files.
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel

rules.title: Suspicious Group And Account Reconnaissance Activity Using Net.EXE
rules.description:
Detects suspicious reconnaissance command line activity on Windows systems using Net.EXE
Check if the user that executed the commands is suspicious (e.g. service accounts, LOCAL_SYSTEM)
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': [{'Image|endswith': ['\\net.exe', '\\net1.exe']}, {'OriginalFileName': ['net.exe', 'net1.exe']}], 'selection_group_root': {'CommandLine|contains': [' group ', ' localgroup ']}, 'selection_group_flags': {'CommandLine|contains': ['domain admins', ' administrator', ' administrateur', 'enterprise admins', 'Exchange Trusted Subsystem', 'Remote Desktop Users', 'Utilisateurs du Bureau à
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), omkar72, @svch0st, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Unmount Share Via Net.EXE
rules.description: Detects when when a mounted share is removed. Adversaries may remove share connections that are no longer useful in order to clean up traces of their operation
rules.author: oscd.community, @redcanary, Zach Stanford @svch0st

rules.title: Start Windows Service Via Net.EXE
rules.description: Detects the usage of the "net.exe" command to start a service using the "start" flag
rules.author: Timur Zinniatullin, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community

rules.title: Stop Windows Service Via Net.EXE
rules.description: Detects the stopping of a Windows service via the "net" utility.
rules.author: Jakob Weinzettl, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Windows Admin Share Mount Via Net.EXE
rules.description: Detects when an admin share is mounted using net.exe
rules.author: oscd.community, Teymur Kheirkhabarov @HeirhabarovT, Zach Stanford @svch0st, wagga

rules.title: Windows Internet Hosted WebDav Share Mount Via Net.EXE
rules.description: Detects when an internet hosted webdav share is mounted using the "net.exe" utility
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Windows Share Mount Via Net.EXE
rules.description: Detects when a share is mounted using the "net.exe" utility
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: System Network Connections Discovery Via Net.EXE
rules.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of network connections to or from the compromised system they are currently accessing or from remote systems by querying for information over the network.
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': [{'Image|endswith': ['\\net.exe', '\\net1.exe']}, {'OriginalFileName': ['net.exe', 'net1.exe']}], 'selection_cli': [{'CommandLine|endswith': [' use', ' sessions']}, {'CommandLine|contains': [' use ', ' sessions ']}], 'condition': 'all of selection_*'}
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Password Provided In Command Line Of Net.EXE
rules.description: Detects a when net.exe is called with a password in the command line
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': [{'Image|endswith': ['\\net.exe', '\\net1.exe']}, {'OriginalFileName': ['net.exe', 'net1.exe']}], 'selection_cli': {'CommandLine|contains|all': [' use ', ':*\\\\', '/USER:* *']}, 'filter_main_empty': {'CommandLine|endswith': ' '}, 'condition': 'all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_*'}
rules.author: Tim Shelton (HAWK.IO)

rules.title: New User Created Via Net.EXE
rules.description: Identifies the creation of local users via the net.exe command.
rules.author: Endgame, JHasenbusch (adapted to Sigma for oscd.community)

rules.title: New User Created Via Net.EXE With Never Expire Option
rules.description: Detects creation of local users via the net.exe command with the option "never expire"
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Manipulation Of Default Accounts Via Net.EXE
rules.description: Detects suspicious manipulations of default accounts such as 'administrator' and 'guest'. For example 'enable' or 'disable' accounts or change the password...etc
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': [{'Image|endswith': ['\\net.exe', '\\net1.exe']}, {'OriginalFileName': ['net.exe', 'net1.exe']}], 'selection_user_option': {'CommandLine|contains': ' user '}, 'selection_username': {'CommandLine|contains': [' Järjestelmänvalvoja ', ' Rendszergazda ', ' Администратор ', ' Administrateur ', ' Administrador ', ' Administratör ', ' Administrator ', ' guest ', ' DefaultAccount ', ' "J
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Share And Session Enumeration Using Net.EXE
rules.description: Detects attempts to enumerate file shares, printer shares and sessions using "net.exe" with the "view" flag.
rules.author: Endgame, JHasenbusch (ported for oscd.community)

rules.title: New Firewall Rule Added Via Netsh.EXE
rules.description: Detects the addition of a new rule to the Windows firewall via netsh
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': [{'Image|endswith': '\\netsh.exe'}, {'OriginalFileName': 'netsh.exe'}], 'selection_cli': {'CommandLine|contains|all': [' firewall ', ' add ']}, 'filter_optional_dropbox': {'CommandLine|contains': ['advfirewall firewall add rule name=Dropbox dir=in action=allow "program=?:\\Program Files (x86)\\Dropbox\\Client\\Dropbox.exe" enable=yes profile=Any', 'advfirewall firewall add rule n
rules.author: Markus Neis, Sander Wiebing

rules.title: Suspicious Program Location Whitelisted In Firewall Via Netsh.EXE
rules.description: Detects Netsh command execution that whitelists a program located in a suspicious location in the Windows Firewall
rules.author: Sander Wiebing, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community

rules.title: RDP Connection Allowed Via Netsh.EXE
rules.description: Detects usage of the netsh command to open and allow connections to port 3389 (RDP). As seen used by Sarwent Malware
rules.author: Sander Wiebing

rules.title: Firewall Rule Deleted Via Netsh.EXE
rules.description: Detects the removal of a port or application rule in the Windows Firewall configuration using netsh
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Firewall Disabled via Netsh.EXE
rules.description: Detects netsh commands that turns off the Windows firewall
rules.author: Fatih Sirin

rules.title: Netsh Allow Group Policy on Microsoft Defender Firewall
rules.description: Adversaries may modify system firewalls in order to bypass controls limiting network usage
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Firewall Configuration Discovery Via Netsh.EXE
rules.description: Adversaries may look for details about the network configuration and settings of systems they access or through information discovery of remote systems
rules.author: frack113, Christopher Peacock '@securepeacock', SCYTHE '@scythe_io'

rules.title: Firewall Rule Update Via Netsh.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of netsh with the "advfirewall" and the "set" option in order to set new values for properties of a existing rule
rules.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Potential Persistence Via Netsh Helper DLL
rules.description: Detects the execution of netsh with "add helper" flag in order to add a custom helper DLL. This technique can be abused to add a malicious helper DLL that can be used as a persistence proxy that gets called when netsh.exe is executed.
rules.author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community

rules.title: New Network Trace Capture Started Via Netsh.EXE
rules.description: Detects the execution of netsh with the "trace" flag in order to start a network capture
rules.author: Kutepov Anton, oscd.community

rules.title: New Port Forwarding Rule Added Via Netsh.EXE
rules.description: Detects the execution of netsh commands that configure a new port forwarding (PortProxy) rule
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), omkar72, oscd.community, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel

rules.title: RDP Port Forwarding Rule Added Via Netsh.EXE
rules.description: Detects the execution of netsh to configure a port forwarding of port 3389 (RDP) rule
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), oscd.community

rules.title: Harvesting Of Wifi Credentials Via Netsh.EXE
rules.description: Detect the harvesting of wifi credentials using netsh.exe
rules.author: Andreas Hunkeler (@Karneades), oscd.community

rules.title: Nltest.EXE Execution
rules.description: Detects nltest commands that can be used for information discovery
rules.author: Arun Chauhan

rules.title: Potential Recon Activity Via Nltest.EXE
rules.description: Detects nltest commands that can be used for information discovery
rules.author: Craig Young, oscd.community, Georg Lauenstein

rules.title: Potential Arbitrary Code Execution Via Node.EXE
rules.description: Detects the execution node.exe which is shipped with multiple software such as VMware, Adobe...etc. In order to execute arbitrary code. For example to establish reverse shell as seen in Log4j attacks...etc
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Node Process Executions
rules.description: Detects the execution of other scripts using the Node executable packaged with Adobe Creative Cloud
rules.detection_summary: {'selection': {'Image|endswith': '\\Adobe Creative Cloud Experience\\libs\\node.exe'}, 'filter': {'CommandLine|contains': 'Adobe Creative Cloud Experience\\js'}, 'condition': 'selection and not filter'}
rules.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Notepad Password Files Discovery
rules.description: Detects the execution of Notepad to open a file that has the string "password" which may indicate unauthorized access to credentials or suspicious activity.
rules.author: The DFIR Report

rules.title: Network Reconnaissance Activity
rules.description: Detects a set of suspicious network related commands often used in recon stages
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Nslookup PowerShell Download Cradle - ProcessCreation
rules.description: Detects suspicious powershell download cradle using nslookup. This cradle uses nslookup to extract payloads from DNS records
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Usage Of Active Directory Diagnostic Tool (ntdsutil.exe)
rules.description: Detects execution of ntdsutil.exe to perform different actions such as restoring snapshots...etc.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Invocation of Active Directory Diagnostic Tool (ntdsutil.exe)
rules.description: Detects execution of ntdsutil.exe, which can be used for various attacks against the NTDS database (NTDS.DIT)
rules.author: Thomas Patzke

rules.title: Driver/DLL Installation Via Odbcconf.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with "INSTALLDRIVER" which installs a new ODBC driver. Attackers abuse this to install and run malicious DLLs.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Driver/DLL Installation Via Odbcconf.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "INSTALLDRIVER" action where the driver doesn't contain a ".dll" extension. This is often used as a defense evasion method.

rules.title: Odbcconf.EXE Suspicious DLL Location
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" where the path of the DLL being registered is located in a potentially suspicious location.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: New DLL Registered Via Odbcconf.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with "REGSVR" in order to register a new DLL (equivalent to running regsvr32). Attackers abuse this to install and run malicious DLLs.
rules.author: Kirill Kiryanov, Beyu Denis, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious DLL Registered Via Odbcconf.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "REGSVR" action where the DLL in question doesn't contain a ".dll" extension. Which is often used as a method to evade defenses.
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': [{'Image|endswith': '\\odbcconf.exe'}, {'OriginalFileName': 'odbcconf.exe'}], 'selection_cli': {'CommandLine|contains': 'REGSVR '}, 'filter_main_dll_ext': {'CommandLine|contains': '.dll'}, 'condition': 'all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_*'}
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Response File Execution Via Odbcconf.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "-f" flag in order to load a response file which might contain a malicious action.
rules.author: Kirill Kiryanov, Beyu Denis, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Response File Execution Via Odbcconf.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "-f" flag in order to load a response file with a non-".rsp" extension.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Uncommon Child Process Spawned By Odbcconf.EXE
rules.description: Detects an uncommon child process of "odbcconf.exe" binary which normally shouldn't have any child processes.
rules.author: Harjot Singh @cyb3rjy0t

rules.title: Potential Arbitrary File Download Using Office Application
rules.description: Detects potential arbitrary file download using a Microsoft Office application

rules.description: Detects the execution of an Office application that points to a document that is located in a trusted location. Attackers often used this to avoid macro security and execute their malicious code.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: OneNote.EXE Execution of Malicious Embedded Scripts
rules.description:
Detects the execution of malicious OneNote documents that contain embedded scripts.
When a user clicks on a OneNote attachment and then on the malicious link inside the ".one" file, it exports and executes the malicious embedded script from specific directories.
rules.author: @kostastsale

rules.title: Suspicious Microsoft OneNote Child Process
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes of the Microsoft OneNote application. This may indicate an attempt to execute malicious embedded objects from a .one file.
rules.author: Tim Rauch (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Elastic (idea)

rules.title: Outlook EnableUnsafeClientMailRules Setting Enabled
rules.description: Detects an attacker trying to enable the outlook security setting "EnableUnsafeClientMailRules" which allows outlook to run applications or execute macros
rules.author: Markus Neis, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Execution From Outlook Temporary Folder
rules.description: Detects a suspicious program execution in Outlook temp folder
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Outlook Child Process
rules.description: Detects a suspicious process spawning from an Outlook process.
rules.author: Michael Haag, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Markus Neis, Elastic, FPT.EagleEye Team

rules.title: Suspicious Remote Child Process From Outlook
rules.description: Detects a suspicious child process spawning from Outlook where the image is located in a remote location (SMB/WebDav shares).
rules.author: Markus Neis, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Binary In User Directory Spawned From Office Application

rules.title: Suspicious Microsoft Office Child Process

rules.author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community

Detects execution of Windows Defender "OfflineScannerShell.exe" from its non standard directory.
The "OfflineScannerShell.exe" binary is vulnerable to DLL side loading and will load any DLL named "mpclient.dll" from the current working directory.
rules.detection_summary: {'selection': [{'Image|endswith': '\\OfflineScannerShell.exe'}, {'OriginalFileName': 'OfflineScannerShell.exe'}], 'filter_main_legit_dir': {'CurrentDirectory': 'C:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\Offline\\'}, 'filter_main_empty': {'CurrentDirectory': ''}, 'filter_main_null': {'CurrentDirectory': None}, 'condition': 'selection and not 1 of filter_main_*'}
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: PDQ Deploy Remote Adminstartion Tool Execution
rules.description: Detect use of PDQ Deploy remote admin tool
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of PDQDeployRunner
rules.description: Detects suspicious execution of "PDQDeployRunner" which is part of the PDQDeploy service stack that is responsible for executing commands and packages on a remote machines
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Perl Inline Command Execution
rules.description: Detects execution of perl using the "-e"/"-E" flags. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live perl code.

rules.title: Php Inline Command Execution

rules.title: Ping Hex IP
rules.description: Detects a ping command that uses a hex encoded IP address

rules.title: PktMon.EXE Execution

rules.title: Suspicious Plink Port Forwarding

rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Potential RDP Tunneling Via Plink

rules.title: Suspicious Powercfg Execution To Change Lock Screen Timeout

rules.title: Potential Active Directory Enumeration Using AD Module - ProcCreation

rules.title: Add Windows Capability Via PowerShell Cmdlet

rules.title: ConvertTo-SecureString Cmdlet Usage Via CommandLine

rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea), Vasiliy Burov (rule), oscd.community, Tim Shelton

rules.title: Potential PowerShell Obfuscation Via Reversed Commands

rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea), Vasiliy Burov (rule), oscd.community, Tim Shelton

rules.title: Obfuscated PowerShell MSI Install via WindowsInstaller COM
rules.description:
Detects the execution of obfuscated PowerShell commands that attempt to install MSI packages via the Windows Installer COM object (`WindowsInstaller.Installer`).
The technique involves manipulating strings to hide functionality, such as constructing class names using string insertion (e.g., 'indowsInstaller.Installer'.Insert(0,'W')) and correcting
malformed URLs (e.g., converting 'htps://' to 'https://') at runtime. This behavior is commonly associated with malware loaders or droppers that aim t
rules.author: Meroujan Antonyan (vx3r)

rules.title: PowerShell MSI Install via WindowsInstaller COM From Remote Location
rules.description:
Detects the execution of PowerShell commands that attempt to install MSI packages via the
Windows Installer COM object (`WindowsInstaller.Installer`) hosted remotely.
This could be indication of malicious software deployment or lateral movement attempts using Windows Installer functionality.
And the usage of WindowsInstaller COM object rather than msiexec could be an attempt to bypass the detection.
rules.author: Meroujan Antonyan (vx3r)

rules.title: Computer Discovery And Export Via Get-ADComputer Cmdlet
rules.description: Detects usage of the Get-ADComputer cmdlet to collect computer information and output it to a file
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Potential PowerShell Console History Access Attempt via History File
rules.description:
Detects potential access attempts to the PowerShell console history directly via history file (ConsoleHost_history.txt).
This can give access to plaintext passwords used in PowerShell commands or used for general reconnaissance.
rules.author: Luc Génaux

rules.title: New Service Creation Using PowerShell
rules.description: Detects the creation of a new service using powershell.

rules.title: Gzip Archive Decode Via PowerShell

rules.title: Obfuscated PowerShell OneLiner Execution
rules.description: Detects the execution of a specific OneLiner to download and execute powershell modules in memory.

rules.title: Potential DLL File Download Via PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest

rules.title: PowerShell Download and Execution Cradles

rules.title: DSInternals Suspicious PowerShell Cmdlets
rules.description:
Detects execution and usage of the DSInternals PowerShell module. Which can be used to perform what might be considered as suspicious activity such as dumping DPAPI backup keys or manipulating NTDS.DIT files.
The DSInternals PowerShell Module exposes several internal features of Active Directory and Azure Active Directory. These include FIDO2 and NGC key auditing, offline ntds.dit file manipulation, password auditing, DC recovery from IFM backups and password hash calculation.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Nounou Mbeiri

rules.title: Email Exifiltration Via Powershell

rules.title: Potential Suspicious Windows Feature Enabled - ProcCreation
rules.description:
Detects usage of the built-in PowerShell cmdlet "Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature" used as a Deployment Image Servicing and Management tool.
Similar to DISM.exe, this cmdlet is used to enumerate, install, uninstall, configure, and update features and packages in Windows images
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Execution of Powershell with Base64

rules.author: Roberto Rodriguez @Cyb3rWard0g (rule), oscd.community (improvements)

rules.title: Potential PowerShell Obfuscation Via WCHAR/CHAR
rules.description: Detects suspicious encoded character syntax often used for defense evasion
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Execution of Powershell Script in Public Folder
rules.description: This rule detects execution of PowerShell scripts located in the "C:\Users\Public" folder
rules.author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: RemoteFXvGPUDisablement Abuse Via AtomicTestHarnesses
rules.description: Detects calls to the AtomicTestHarnesses "Invoke-ATHRemoteFXvGPUDisablementCommand" which is designed to abuse the "RemoteFXvGPUDisablement.exe" binary to run custom PowerShell code via module load-order hijacking.
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Tamper Windows Defender Remove-MpPreference
rules.description: Detects attempts to remove Windows Defender configurations using the 'MpPreference' cmdlet
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Potential Powershell ReverseShell Connection
rules.description: Detects usage of the "TcpClient" class. Which can be abused to establish remote connections and reverse-shells. As seen used by the Nishang "Invoke-PowerShellTcpOneLine" reverse shell and other.
rules.author: FPT.EagleEye, wagga, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Run PowerShell Script from ADS
rules.description: Detects PowerShell script execution from Alternate Data Stream (ADS)
rules.author: Sergey Soldatov, Kaspersky Lab, oscd.community

rules.title: Run PowerShell Script from Redirected Input Stream
rules.description: Detects PowerShell script execution via input stream redirect
rules.author: Moriarty Meng (idea), Anton Kutepov (rule), oscd.community

rules.title: PowerShell SAM Copy
rules.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell scripts accessing SAM hives
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell Invocation From Script Engines
rules.description: Detects suspicious powershell invocations from interpreters or unusual programs
rules.detection_summary: {'selection': {'ParentImage|endswith': ['\\wscript.exe', '\\cscript.exe'], 'Image|endswith': ['\\powershell.exe', '\\pwsh.exe']}, 'filter_health_service': {'CurrentDirectory|contains': '\\Health Service State\\'}, 'condition': 'selection and not 1 of filter_*'}
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Service DACL Modification Via Set-Service Cmdlet
rules.description: Detects suspicious DACL modifications via the "Set-Service" cmdlet using the "SecurityDescriptorSddl" flag (Only available with PowerShell 7) that can be used to hide services or make them unstopable
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PowerShell Script Change Permission Via Set-Acl
rules.description: Detects PowerShell execution to set the ACL of a file or a folder
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PowerShell Set-Acl On Windows Folder
rules.description: Detects PowerShell scripts to set the ACL to a file in the Windows folder
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Change PowerShell Policies to an Insecure Level
rules.description: Detects changing the PowerShell script execution policy to a potentially insecure level using the "-ExecutionPolicy" flag.
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Service StartupType Change Via PowerShell Set-Service
rules.description: Detects the use of the PowerShell "Set-Service" cmdlet to change the startup type of a service to "disabled" or "manual"
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Deletion of Volume Shadow Copies via WMI with PowerShell
rules.description: Detects deletion of Windows Volume Shadow Copies with PowerShell code and Get-WMIObject. This technique is used by numerous ransomware families such as Sodinokibi/REvil
rules.author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)

rules.title: Exchange PowerShell Snap-Ins Usage
rules.description: Detects adding and using Exchange PowerShell snap-ins to export mailbox data. As seen used by HAFNIUM and APT27
rules.author: FPT.EagleEye, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Stop Windows Service Via PowerShell Stop-Service
rules.description: Detects the stopping of a Windows service via the PowerShell Cmdlet "Stop-Service"
rules.author: Jakob Weinzettl, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell Download and Execute Pattern
rules.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell download patterns that are often used in malicious scripts, stagers or downloaders (make sure that your backend applies the strings case-insensitive)
rules.detection_summary: {'selection': {'CommandLine|contains': ['IEX ((New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString', 'IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString', 'IEX((New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString', 'IEX(New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString', ' -command (New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadFile(', ' -c (New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadFile(']}, 'condition': 'selection'}
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell Parameter Substring
rules.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell invocation with a parameter substring
rules.detection_summary: {'selection': {'Image|endswith': ['\\powershell.exe', '\\pwsh.exe'], 'CommandLine|contains': [' -windowstyle h ', ' -windowstyl h', ' -windowsty h', ' -windowst h', ' -windows h', ' -windo h', ' -wind h', ' -win h', ' -wi h', ' -win h ', ' -win hi ', ' -win hid ', ' -win hidd ', ' -win hidde ', ' -NoPr ', ' -NoPro ', ' -NoProf ', ' -NoProfi ', ' -NoProfil ', ' -nonin ', ' -nonint ', ' -noninte ',
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Daniel Bohannon (idea), Roberto Rodriguez (Fix)

rules.title: Suspicious PowerShell Parent Process
rules.description: Detects a suspicious or uncommon parent processes of PowerShell
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Harish Segar

rules.title: PowerShell Script Run in AppData
rules.description: Detects a suspicious command line execution that invokes PowerShell with reference to an AppData folder
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community

rules.title: Powershell Token Obfuscation - Process Creation
rules.description: Detects TOKEN OBFUSCATION technique from Invoke-Obfuscation
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Suspicious Uninstall of Windows Defender Feature via PowerShell
rules.description: Detects the use of PowerShell with Uninstall-WindowsFeature or Remove-WindowsFeature cmdlets to disable or remove the Windows Defender GUI feature, a common technique used by adversaries to evade defenses.
rules.author: yxinmiracle

rules.title: User Discovery And Export Via Get-ADUser Cmdlet
rules.description: Detects usage of the Get-ADUser cmdlet to collect user information and output it to a file
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Net WebClient Casing Anomalies
rules.description: Detects PowerShell command line contents that include a suspicious abnormal casing in the Net.Webclient (e.g. nEt.WEbCliEnT) string as used in obfuscation techniques
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious X509Enrollment - Process Creation
rules.description: Detect use of X509Enrollment
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Suspicious XOR Encoded PowerShell Command
rules.description: Detects presence of a potentially xor encoded powershell command
rules.author: Sami Ruohonen, Harish Segar, Tim Shelton, Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Vasiliy Burov, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali

rules.title: Folder Compress To Potentially Suspicious Output Via Compress-Archive Cmdlet
rules.description:
Detects PowerShell scripts that make use of the "Compress-Archive" Cmdlet in order to compress folders and files where the output is stored in a potentially suspicious location that is used often by malware for exfiltration.
An adversary might compress data (e.g., sensitive documents) that is collected prior to exfiltration in order to make it portable and minimize the amount of data sent over the network.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113

rules.title: Arbitrary File Download Via PresentationHost.EXE
rules.description: Detects usage of "PresentationHost" which is a utility that runs ".xbap" (Browser Applications) files to download arbitrary files
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: XBAP Execution From Uncommon Locations Via PresentationHost.EXE
rules.description: Detects the execution of ".xbap" (Browser Applications) files via PresentationHost.EXE from an uncommon location. These files can be abused to run malicious ".xbap" files any bypass AWL
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': [{'Image|endswith': '\\presentationhost.exe'}, {'OriginalFileName': 'PresentationHost.exe'}], 'selection_cli': {'CommandLine|contains': '.xbap'}, 'filter_main_generic': {'CommandLine|contains': [' C:\\Windows\\', ' C:\\Program Files']}, 'condition': 'all of selection* and not 1 of filter_main_*'}
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Visual Studio NodejsTools PressAnyKey Arbitrary Binary Execution
rules.description: Detects child processes of Microsoft.NodejsTools.PressAnyKey.exe that can be used to execute any other binary
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Abusing Print Executable
rules.description: Attackers can use print.exe for remote file copy
rules.author: Furkan CALISKAN, @caliskanfurkan_, @oscd_initiative

rules.title: File Download Using ProtocolHandler.exe
rules.description: Detects usage of "ProtocolHandler" to download files. Downloaded files will be located in the cache folder (for example - %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\INetCache\IE)
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Potential Provlaunch.EXE Binary Proxy Execution Abuse
rules.description: Detects child processes of "provlaunch.exe" which might indicate potential abuse to proxy execution.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel

rules.title: Suspicious Provlaunch.EXE Child Process
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes of "provlaunch.exe" which might indicate potential abuse to proxy execution.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Screen Capture Activity Via Psr.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of Windows Problem Steps Recorder (psr.exe), a utility used to record the user screen and clicks.
rules.author: Beyu Denis, oscd.community

rules.title: PUA - 3Proxy Execution
rules.description: Detects the use of 3proxy, a tiny free proxy server
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - Suspicious ActiveDirectory Enumeration Via AdFind.EXE
rules.description: Detects active directory enumeration activity using known AdFind CLI flags
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: PUA - AdFind.EXE Execution
rules.description: Detects execution of Adfind.exe utility, which can be used for reconnaissance in an Active Directory environment
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - AdFind Suspicious Execution
rules.description: Detects AdFind execution with common flags seen used during attacks
rules.author: Janantha Marasinghe (https://github.com/blueteam0ps), FPT.EagleEye Team, omkar72, oscd.community

rules.title: PUA - Advanced IP Scanner Execution
rules.description: Detects the use of Advanced IP Scanner. Seems to be a popular tool for ransomware groups.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), @ROxPinTeddy

rules.title: PUA - Advanced Port Scanner Execution
rules.description: Detects the use of Advanced Port Scanner.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - AdvancedRun Execution
rules.description: Detects the execution of AdvancedRun utility
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - AdvancedRun Suspicious Execution
rules.description: Detects the execution of AdvancedRun utility in the context of the TrustedInstaller, SYSTEM, Local Service or Network Service accounts
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - Chisel Tunneling Tool Execution
rules.description: Detects usage of the Chisel tunneling tool via the commandline arguments
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': {'Image|endswith': '\\chisel.exe'}, 'selection_param1': {'CommandLine|contains': ['exe client ', 'exe server ']}, 'selection_param2': {'CommandLine|contains': ['-socks5', '-reverse', ' r:', ':127.0.0.1:', '-tls-skip-verify ', ':socks']}, 'condition': 'selection_img or all of selection_param*'}
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - CleanWipe Execution
rules.description: Detects the use of CleanWipe a tool usually used to delete Symantec antivirus.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - Crassus Execution
rules.description: Detects Crassus, a Windows privilege escalation discovery tool, based on PE metadata characteristics.
rules.author: pH-T (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - CsExec Execution
rules.description: Detects the use of the lesser known remote execution tool named CsExec a PsExec alternative
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - DefenderCheck Execution
rules.description: Detects the use of DefenderCheck, a tool to evaluate the signatures used in Microsoft Defender. It can be used to figure out the strings / byte chains used in Microsoft Defender to detect a tool and thus used for AV evasion.
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - DIT Snapshot Viewer
rules.description: Detects the use of Ditsnap tool, an inspection tool for Active Directory database, ntds.dit.
rules.author: Furkan Caliskan (@caliskanfurkan_)

rules.title: PUA - Fast Reverse Proxy (FRP) Execution
rules.description: Detects the use of Fast Reverse Proxy. frp is a fast reverse proxy to help you expose a local server behind a NAT or firewall to the Internet.
rules.author: frack113, Florian Roth

rules.title: PUA- IOX Tunneling Tool Execution
rules.description: Detects the use of IOX - a tool for port forwarding and intranet proxy purposes
rules.detection_summary: {'selection': {'Image|endswith': '\\iox.exe'}, 'selection_commandline': {'CommandLine|contains': ['.exe fwd -l ', '.exe fwd -r ', '.exe proxy -l ', '.exe proxy -r ']}, 'selection_hashes': {'Hashes|contains': ['MD5=9DB2D314DD3F704A02051EF5EA210993', 'SHA1=039130337E28A6623ECF9A0A3DA7D92C5964D8DD', 'SHA256=C6CF82919B809967D9D90EA73772A8AA1C1EB3BC59252D977500F64F1A0D6731']}, 'condition': '1 of select
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - Kernel Driver Utility (KDU) Execution
rules.description:
Detects execution of the Kernel Driver Utility (KDU) tool.
KDU can be used to bypass driver signature enforcement and load unsigned or malicious drivers into the Windows kernel.
Potentially allowing for privilege escalation, persistence, or evasion of security controls.
rules.author: Matt Anderson, Dray Agha, Anna Pham (Huntress)

rules.title: PUA - Mouse Lock Execution
rules.description: In Kaspersky's 2020 Incident Response Analyst Report they listed legitimate tool "Mouse Lock" as being used for both credential access and collection in security incidents.
rules.author: Cian Heasley

rules.title: PUA - Netcat Suspicious Execution
rules.description: Detects execution of Netcat. Adversaries may use a non-application layer protocol for communication between host and C2 server or among infected hosts within a network
rules.author: frack113, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - SoftPerfect Netscan Execution
rules.description:
Detects usage of SoftPerfect's "netscan.exe". An application for scanning networks.
It is actively used in-the-wild by threat actors to inspect and understand the network architecture of a victim.
rules.author: @d4ns4n_ (Wuerth-Phoenix)

rules.title: PUA - Ngrok Execution
rules.description:
Detects the use of Ngrok, a utility used for port forwarding and tunneling, often used by threat actors to make local protected services publicly available.
Involved domains are bin.equinox.io for download and *.ngrok.io for connections.
rules.detection_summary: {'selection1': {'CommandLine|contains': [' tcp 139', ' tcp 445', ' tcp 3389', ' tcp 5985', ' tcp 5986']}, 'selection2': {'CommandLine|contains|all': [' start ', '--all', '--config', '.yml']}, 'selection3': {'Image|endswith': 'ngrok.exe', 'CommandLine|contains': [' tcp ', ' http ', ' authtoken ']}, 'selection4': {'CommandLine|contains': ['.exe authtoken ', '.exe start --all']}, 'condition': '1 of s
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - Nimgrab Execution
rules.description: Detects the usage of nimgrab, a tool bundled with the Nim programming framework and used for downloading files.
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: PUA - NimScan Execution
rules.description:
Detects usage of NimScan, a portscanner utility.
In early 2025, adversaries were observed using this utility to scan for open ports on remote hosts in a compromised environment.
This rule identifies the execution of NimScan based on the process image name and specific hash values associated with different versions of the tool.
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - NirCmd Execution
rules.description: Detects the use of NirCmd tool for command execution, which could be the result of legitimate administrative activity
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_org': [{'Image|endswith': '\\NirCmd.exe'}, {'OriginalFileName': 'NirCmd.exe'}], 'selection_cmd': {'CommandLine|contains': [' execmd ', '.exe script ', '.exe shexec ', ' runinteractive ']}, 'combo_exec': {'CommandLine|contains': [' exec ', ' exec2 ']}, 'combo_exec_params': {'CommandLine|contains': [' show ', ' hide ']}, 'condition': '1 of selection_* or all of combo_*'}
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - NirCmd Execution As LOCAL SYSTEM
rules.description: Detects the use of NirCmd tool for command execution as SYSTEM user
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - Nmap/Zenmap Execution
rules.description: Detects usage of namp/zenmap. Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts, including those that may be vulnerable to remote software exploitation
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: PUA - NPS Tunneling Tool Execution
rules.description: Detects the use of NPS, a port forwarding and intranet penetration proxy server
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - NSudo Execution
rules.description: Detects the use of NSudo tool for command execution
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali

rules.title: PUA - PingCastle Execution
rules.description: Detects the execution of PingCastle, a tool designed to quickly assess the Active Directory security level.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113

rules.title: PUA - PingCastle Execution From Potentially Suspicious Parent
rules.description: Detects the execution of PingCastle, a tool designed to quickly assess the Active Directory security level via a script located in a potentially suspicious or uncommon location.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), X__Junior (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - Process Hacker Execution
rules.description:
Detects the execution of Process Hacker based on binary metadata information (Image, Hash, Imphash, etc).
Process Hacker is a tool to view and manipulate processes, kernel options and other low level options.
Threat actors abused older vulnerable versions to manipulate system processes.
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - Radmin Viewer Utility Execution
rules.description: Detects the execution of Radmin which can be abused by an adversary to remotely control Windows machines
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: PUA - Potential PE Metadata Tamper Using Rcedit
rules.description: Detects the use of rcedit to potentially alter executable PE metadata properties, which could conceal efforts to rename system utilities for defense evasion.
rules.author: Micah Babinski

rules.title: PUA - Rclone Execution
rules.description: Detects execution of RClone utility for exfiltration as used by various ransomwares strains like REvil, Conti, FiveHands, etc
rules.author: Bhabesh Raj, Sittikorn S, Aaron Greetham (@beardofbinary) - NCC Group

rules.title: PUA - Restic Backup Tool Execution
rules.description:
Detects the execution of the Restic backup tool, which can be used for data exfiltration.
Threat actors may leverage Restic to back up and exfiltrate sensitive data to remote storage locations, including cloud services.
If not legitimately used in the enterprise environment, its presence may indicate malicious activity.
rules.author: Nounou Mbeiri, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - RunXCmd Execution
rules.description: Detects the use of the RunXCmd tool to execute commands with System or TrustedInstaller accounts
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - Seatbelt Execution
rules.description: Detects the execution of the PUA/Recon tool Seatbelt via PE information of command line parameters
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': [{'Image|endswith': '\\Seatbelt.exe'}, {'OriginalFileName': 'Seatbelt.exe'}, {'Description': 'Seatbelt'}, {'CommandLine|contains': [' DpapiMasterKeys', ' InterestingProcesses', ' InterestingFiles', ' CertificateThumbprints', ' ChromiumBookmarks', ' ChromiumHistory', ' ChromiumPresence', ' CloudCredentials', ' CredEnum', ' CredGuard', ' FirefoxHistory', ' ProcessCreationEvents']}]
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - System Informer Execution
rules.description: Detects the execution of System Informer, a task manager tool to view and manipulate processes, kernel options and other low level operations
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - TruffleHog Execution
rules.description:
Detects execution of TruffleHog, a tool used to search for secrets in different platforms like Git, Jira, Slack, SharePoint, etc. that could be used maliciously.
While it is a legitimate tool, intended for use in CI pipelines and security assessments,
It was observed in the Shai-Hulud malware campaign targeting npm packages to steal sensitive information.
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': {'Image|endswith': '\\trufflehog.exe'}, 'selection_cli_platform': {'CommandLine|contains': [' docker --image ', ' Git ', ' GitHub ', ' Jira ', ' Slack ', ' Confluence ', ' SharePoint ', ' s3 ', ' gcs ']}, 'selection_cli_verified': {'CommandLine|contains': ' --results=verified'}, 'condition': 'selection_img or all of selection_cli_*'}
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - WebBrowserPassView Execution
rules.description: Detects the execution of WebBrowserPassView.exe. A password recovery tool that reveals the passwords stored by the following Web browsers, Internet Explorer (Version 4.0 - 11.0), Mozilla Firefox (All Versions), Google Chrome, Safari, and Opera
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: PUA - Wsudo Suspicious Execution
rules.description: Detects usage of wsudo (Windows Sudo Utility). Which is a tool that let the user execute programs with different permissions (System, Trusted Installer, Administrator...etc)
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_metadata': [{'Image|endswith': '\\wsudo.exe'}, {'OriginalFileName': 'wsudo.exe'}, {'Description': 'Windows sudo utility'}, {'ParentImage|endswith': '\\wsudo-bridge.exe'}], 'selection_cli': {'CommandLine|contains': ['-u System', '-uSystem', '-u TrustedInstaller', '-uTrustedInstaller', ' --ti ']}, 'condition': '1 of selection_*'}
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: PUA - Adidnsdump Execution
rules.description:
This tool enables enumeration and exporting of all DNS records in the zone for recon purposes of internal networks Python 3 and python.exe must be installed,
Usee to Query/modify DNS records for Active Directory integrated DNS via LDAP
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Python Inline Command Execution
rules.description: Detects execution of python using the "-c" flag. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live python code.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Python Spawning Pretty TTY on Windows
rules.description: Detects python spawning a pretty tty
rules.detection_summary: {'selection_img': {'Image|endswith': ['python.exe', 'python3.exe', 'python2.exe']}, 'selection_cli_1': {'CommandLine|contains|all': ['import pty', '.spawn(']}, 'selection_cli_2': {'CommandLine|contains': 'from pty import spawn'}, 'condition': 'selection_img and 1 of selection_cli_*'}
rules.author: Nextron Systems

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Usage Of Qemu
rules.description:
Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Qemu utility in a Windows environment.
Threat actors have leveraged this utility and this technique for achieving network access as reported by Kaspersky.
rules.author: Muhammad Faisal (@faisalusuf), Hunter Juhan (@threatHNTR)

rules.title: Query Usage To Exfil Data
rules.description: Detects usage of "query.exe" a system binary to exfil information such as "sessions" and "processes" for later use
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: QuickAssist Execution
rules.description: Detects the execution of Microsoft Quick Assist tool "QuickAssist.exe". This utility can be used by attackers to gain remote access.
rules.author: Muhammad Faisal (@faisalusuf)

rules.title: Files Added To An Archive Using Rar.EXE
rules.description: Detects usage of "rar" to add files to an archive for potential compression. An adversary may compress data (e.g. sensitive documents) that is collected prior to exfiltration in order to make it portable and minimize the amount of data sent over the network.
rules.author: Timur Zinniatullin, E.M. Anhaus, oscd.community

rules.title: Rar Usage with Password and Compression Level
rules.description: Detects the use of rar.exe, on the command line, to create an archive with password protection or with a specific compression level. This is pretty indicative of malicious actions.
rules.author: @ROxPinTeddy

rules.title: Suspicious Greedy Compression Using Rar.EXE
rules.description: Detects RAR usage that creates an archive from a suspicious folder, either a system folder or one of the folders often used by attackers for staging purposes
rules.author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious RASdial Activity
rules.description: Detects suspicious process related to rasdial.exe
rules.author: juju4

rules.title: RDP Enable or Disable via Win32_TerminalServiceSetting WMI Class
rules.description:
Detects enabling or disabling of Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) using alternate methods such as WMIC or PowerShell.
In PowerShell one-liner commands, the "SetAllowTSConnections" method of the "Win32_TerminalServiceSetting" class may be used to enable or disable RDP.
In WMIC, the "rdtoggle" alias or "Win32_TerminalServiceSetting" class may be used for the same purpose.
rules.author: Daniel Koifman (KoifSec), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Process Memory Dump via RdrLeakDiag.EXE
rules.description: Detects the use of the Microsoft Windows Resource Leak Diagnostic tool "rdrleakdiag.exe" to dump process memory
rules.author: Cedric MAURUGEON, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Windows Recovery Environment Disabled Via Reagentc
rules.description:
Detects attempts to disable windows recovery environment using Reagentc.
ReAgentc.exe is a command-line tool in Windows used to manage the Windows Recovery Environment (WinRE).
It allows users to enable, disable, and configure WinRE, which is used for troubleshooting and repairing common boot issues.
rules.author: Daniel Koifman (KoifSec), Michael Vilshin

rules.title: Potential Persistence Attempt Via Run Keys Using Reg.EXE
rules.description: Detects suspicious command line reg.exe tool adding key to RUN key in Registry
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Add SafeBoot Keys Via Reg Utility
rules.description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" commands with the "add" or "copy" flags on safe boot registry keys. Often used by attacker to allow the ransomware to work in safe mode as some security products do not
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Reg Add BitLocker
rules.description: Detects suspicious addition to BitLocker related registry keys via the reg.exe utility
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Dropping Of Password Filter DLL
rules.description: Detects dropping of dll files in system32 that may be used to retrieve user credentials from LSASS
rules.author: Sreeman

rules.title: Suspicious Windows Defender Folder Exclusion Added Via Reg.EXE
rules.description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" to add Defender folder exclusions. Qbot has been seen using this technique to add exclusions for folders within AppData and ProgramData.
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: RunMRU Registry Key Deletion
rules.description:
Detects deletion of the RunMRU registry key, which stores the history of commands executed via the Run dialog.
In the clickfix techniques, the phishing lures instruct users to open a run dialog through (Win + R) and execute malicious commands.
Adversaries may delete this key to cover their tracks after executing commands.
rules.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: SafeBoot Registry Key Deleted Via Reg.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" commands with the "delete" flag on safe boot registry keys. Often used by attacker to prevent safeboot execution of security products
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Tim Shelton

rules.title: Service Registry Key Deleted Via Reg.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" commands with the "delete" flag on services registry key. Often used by attacker to remove AV software services
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Desktop Background Change Using Reg.EXE
rules.description:
Detects the execution of "reg.exe" to alter registry keys that would replace the user's desktop background.
This is a common technique used by malware to change the desktop background to a ransom note or other image.
rules.author: Stephen Lincoln @slincoln-aiq (AttackIQ)

rules.title: Direct Autorun Keys Modification
rules.description: Detects direct modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry using reg.exe.
rules.author: Victor Sergeev, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Disabling Windows Defender WMI Autologger Session via Reg.exe
rules.description:
Detects the use of reg.exe to disable the Event Tracing for Windows (ETW) Autologger session for Windows Defender API and Audit events.
By setting the 'Start' value to '0' for the 'DefenderApiLogger' or 'DefenderAuditLogger' session, an attacker can prevent these critical security events
from being logged, effectively blinding monitoring tools that rely on this data. This is a powerful defense evasion technique.
rules.author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)

rules.title: Security Service Disabled Via Reg.EXE
rules.description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" to disable security services such as Windows Defender.
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), John Lambert (idea), elhoim

rules.title: Dumping of Sensitive Hives Via Reg.EXE
rules.description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" in order to dump sensitive registry hives. This includes SAM, SYSTEM and SECURITY hives.
rules.author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Endgame, JHasenbusch, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, frack113

rules.title: Windows Recall Feature Enabled Via Reg.EXE
rules.description:
Detects the enabling of the Windows Recall feature via registry manipulation.
Windows Recall can be enabled by deleting the existing "DisableAIDataAnalysis" value, or setting it to 0.
Adversaries may enable Windows Recall as part of post-exploitation discovery and collection activities.
This rule assumes that Recall is already explicitly disabled on the host, and subsequently enabled by the adversary.
rules.author: Sajid Nawaz Khan

rules.title: Enumeration for Credentials in Registry
rules.description:
Adversaries may search the Registry on compromised systems for insecurely stored credentials.
The Windows Registry stores configuration information that can be used by the system or other programs.
Adversaries may query the Registry looking for credentials and passwords that have been stored for use by other programs or services
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Potential Suspicious Registry File Imported Via Reg.EXE
rules.description: Detects the import of '.reg' files from suspicious paths using the 'reg.exe' utility
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali

rules.title: RestrictedAdminMode Registry Value Tampering - ProcCreation
rules.description:
Detects changes to the "DisableRestrictedAdmin" registry value in order to disable or enable RestrictedAdmin mode.
RestrictedAdmin mode prevents the transmission of reusable credentials to the remote system to which you connect using Remote Desktop.
This prevents your credentials from being harvested during the initial connection process if the remote server has been compromise
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: LSA PPL Protection Disabled Via Reg.EXE
rules.description: Detects the usage of the "reg.exe" utility to disable PPL protection on the LSA process
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Query of MachineGUID
rules.description: Use of reg to get MachineGuid information
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Modify Group Policy Settings
rules.description: Detect malicious GPO modifications can be used to implement many other malicious behaviors.
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Enable LM Hash Storage - ProcCreation
rules.description:
Detects changes to the "NoLMHash" registry value in order to allow Windows to store LM Hashes.
By setting this registry value to "0" (DWORD), Windows will be allowed to store a LAN manager hash of your password in Active Directory and local SAM databases.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Potential Configuration And Service Reconnaissance Via Reg.EXE
rules.description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" in order to query reconnaissance information from the registry. Adversaries may interact with the Windows registry to gather information about credentials, the system, configuration, and installed software.
rules.author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community

rules.title: Potential Tampering With RDP Related Registry Keys Via Reg.EXE
rules.description: Detects the execution of "reg.exe" for enabling/disabling the RDP service on the host by tampering with the 'CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' values
rules.author: pH-T (Nextron Systems), @Kostastsale, TheDFIRReport

rules.title: Suspicious ScreenSave Change by Reg.exe
rules.description:
Adversaries may establish persistence by executing malicious content triggered by user inactivity.
Screensavers are programs that execute after a configurable time of user inactivity and consist of Portable Executable (PE) files with a .scr file extension

rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Changing Existing Service ImagePath Value Via Reg.EXE
rules.description:
Adversaries may execute their own malicious payloads by hijacking the Registry entries used by services.
Adversaries may use flaws in the permissions for registry to redirect from the originally specified executable to one that they control, in order to launch their own code at Service start.
Windows stores local service configuration information in the Registry under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Detected Windows Software Discovery
rules.description: Adversaries may attempt to enumerate software for a variety of reasons, such as figuring out what security measures are present or if the compromised system has a version of software that is vulnerable.
rules.author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community

rules.title: Reg Add Suspicious Paths
rules.description: Detects when an adversary uses the reg.exe utility to add or modify new keys or subkeys
rules.author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: System Language Discovery via Reg.Exe
rules.description:
Detects the usage of Reg.Exe to query system language settings.
Attackers may discover the system language to determine the geographic location of victims, customize payloads for specific regions,
or avoid targeting certain locales to evade detection.
rules.author: Marco Pedrinazzi (@pedrinazziM) (InTheCyber)

rules.title: Disabled Volume Snapshots
rules.description: Detects commands that temporarily turn off Volume Snapshots
rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Suspicious Windows Defender Registry Key Tampering Via Reg.EXE
rules.description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" to tamper with different Windows Defender registry keys in order to disable some important features related to protection and detection

rules.author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Write Protect For Storage Disabled
rules.description:
Detects applications trying to modify the registry in order to disable any write-protect property for storage devices.
This could be a precursor to a ransomware attack and has been an observed technique used by cypherpunk group.
rules.author: Sreeman

rules.title: RegAsm.EXE Execution Without CommandLine Flags or Files
rules.description:
Detects the execution of "RegAsm.exe" without a commandline flag or file, which might indicate potential process injection activity.
Usually "RegAsm.exe" should point to a dedicated DLL file or call the help with the "/?" flag.
rules.author: frack113

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of Regasm/Regsvcs With Uncommon Extension
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Regasm/Regsvcs utilities with an uncommon extension.
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of Regasm/Regsvcs From Uncommon Location
rules.description: Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Regasm/Regsvcs utilities from a potentially suspicious location
rules.author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

rules.title: Exports Critical Registry Keys To a File
rules.description: Detects the export of a crital Registry key to a file.
rules.author: Oddvar Moe, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community

rules.title: Exports Registry Key To a File
rules.description: Detects the export of the target Registry key to a file.

rules.author: Oddvar Moe, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community

rules.title: Imports Registry Key From a File
rules.description: Detects the import of the specified file to the registry with regedit.exe.
